 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Keep left-panel foreground cells where the aligned right cell is background."""
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)

    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = max({v for row in left for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row))
    left_fg = next(v for v in {x for row in left for x in row} if v != left_bg)
    right_bg = max({v for row in right for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in right for x in row))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == left_fg and right[r][c] == right_bg else left_fg for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
"
}
